title: Every Tracy EmDash quickstart lists sharp as its own dependency, so /_image does not answer 500 MissingSharp
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (no stand needed) run: node --test scripts/test/emdash-templates-sharp.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`.
expect: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `pass 6` and `fail 0`.
For base, business and saas: `sharp is a direct dependency, pinned exactly` and `the lockfile installs sharp at the root, not as an optional extra` pass.
evidence: Before: stand containers of tracy-business-emdash:1.5.1-tools, tracy-base-emdash:0.3.0-tools and tracy-saas-emdash:1.2.0-tools answered /_image 500 with `MissingSharp: Could not find Sharp` (loadSharp in dist/server/chunks/sharp_*.mjs); sharp sat only in node_modules/.pnpm as Astro's optional dependency, and Vite bundled it into dist because EmDash is ssr.noExternal. After: an image built from each fixed package has node_modules/sharp and answers 200 image/webp (measured 11/10/2026 on the Studio, throwaway containers).
fence: The lockfile and package.json of the three templates; it does not prove a released quickstart was re-cut — that needs the release on ja-products and a new site image.
